# Support

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](SUPPORT.vi.md)

Use issue templates for runtime bugs, documentation gaps, feature proposals and reproducibility questions. Include commit SHA, Kaggle accelerator, library versions and the smallest reproducible case.

Security-sensitive reports belong in the private channel described by [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
